description: This file defines the SystemUserController class within the OrangeHRM admin plugin, responsible for handling system user management operations, particularly the preRender method that prepares a Vue component with data about undeletable user IDs.

classes.name: SystemUserController
classes.description: Controller managing system user-related views and actions, extending AbstractVueController and utilizing UserServiceTrait.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with data before rendering, specifically adding a property with undeletable user IDs.
